name: logseq-import-chatgpt-deep-research
description: Convert a ChatGPT Deep Research report into a Logseq-Flavored Markdown page, from its PDF and optional Markdown export. Use when the user gives a Deep Research PDF or asks to import/file a Deep Research report with preserved URL footnotes, Logseq-Flavored Markdown, existing-page links, and today's journal summary. This skill converts the report into a page; it does not archive the original PDF/Markdown export as a binary asset in the repo. This skill is the entrypoint for that import workflow.
